text:
Jordan H: quick async — mini-standup for gateway work. what I did: deployed routing-policy patch to staging (policy v2). ran perf sweep for 512-token window, KV cache hit rate up ~12%. blocked: seeing intermittent 429s when simulating thin bursts, not consistent across pods.
Jordan H: what I'll do today: pair with Samir on the canary rollout, add extra logging around token-bucket refills, and open a small PR to lower burst window for affected route. will also triage auth token rotation logs.
Samir K: saw the 429s on my harness too. looked like a race between autoscaler and token-bucket refill. suspect quota refill timers misaligned after pod restart. can reproduce with local script (low concurrency + sudden spike). :mag:
Samir K: quick snippet I used to repro:
```bash
for i in {1..300}; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer test" https://staging-gw.internal/api/predict & done; wait
```
Lee P: I pulled logs for the pods that returned 429s — rate limiter shows tokens exhausted, but the refill event occurs ~150ms later than expected. adding more metrics to token-bucket should help. leaving a note on the PR.
Lee P: also noticed auth middleware retries (on 401) sometimes trigger extra requests that eat bursts. small fix queued in my branch.
Tess M: ping on reviews — Jordan's routing-policy change (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/pull/842) needs one more approval, and my auth-rotation PR is waiting on integration tests. can we prioritize? :eyes:
Jordan H: thanks — Samir and Lee can you review the policy PR? Samir for canary logic, Lee for rate limiter interaction. I can merge after approvals and then kick canary.
Samir K: will review in next 30m. if green, I'll start a small canary (10% traffic) and watch error budget. can we set automatic rollback on >1.5% 5m error rate?
Jordan H: yes — set canary policy to rollback threshold 1.5% (5m). also enable extra tracing for that canary only.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated: gateway-policy-v2 -> 10% traffic. canary_id=gw-canary-5161239876. monitor: https://console.redwood/mon/gw-canary-5161239876
Lee P: I'll attach the token-bucket metrics and a short graph to the canary dashboard.
Tess M: I'll re-run integration tests against the canary endpoint and report back.
Jordan H: blockers summary: primary blocker is the thin-burst 429 reproduction; next steps are extra logging, small rate-limit timing tweak, and canary. if anyone sees unexpected errors, ping here and tag @oncall. thanks! :thumbsup:
